title: Model serving spec
description: Joins the model store and the role table (ADR-0023): per svc: backend the role table binds, the engine that serves it (vllm or llama-server; Unsloth Studio is the GUI, not a backend), its port, GPUs and engine settings. homelabnext.models.serving derives the one store entry each backend serves and renders the vllm_server role's instances (--served-model-name = the binding's model id, --max-model-len = the roles' max_context_tokens, --scheduling-policy priority); the LLM gateway generator reads the same file (serving: in a gateway spec) for its local backends. Semantic rules (bindings resolve, one model per vLLM backend, tp x pp = number of GPUs, unique ports and GPUs) are checked there (`hnx models serving check`).

store.description: Path of the model store manifest, relative to this file.

roles.description: Path of the model-role table, relative to this file.

exposure.description: Where the engines listen: zone (the host's zone address; the gateway reaches each backend as <name>.svc.<domain>, the host firewall admits only it) or loopback (the host's loopback alone; the gateway generator refuses such a plan). Rendered as vllm_server_exposure, which holds vllm_server_listen_address to it.

gpus.description: GPU indexes in PCI bus order (CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID); a GPU belongs to one backend.

args.description: Extra vLLM flags (exact name without --) from an allowlist (homelabnext.models.serving.ALLOWED_ARGS), each with a typed value: a number in range, a choice, a short name, or a boolean (true renders the bare flag, false nothing). No value starts with '-'. Flags the plan sets (model, served-model-name, max-model-len, scheduling-policy, host, port, parallelism, ...) and flags that load files, code or JSON are refused.
